facts.fact: The page headline, as shown in the chunk's URL slug and share-link text, says NCAA expands March Madness brackets and adds $50m per year in broadcast income; the article body is not in this chunk, so the figure is unverified here.
The NCAA confirmed that its men's and women's national basketball championships will each grow from 68 teams to 76 teams from the 2027 editions onward.
facts.quote: which will each grow from 68 teams to 76 from the 2027 editions onward.

facts.fact: Eight teams will be added to each championship's first round under the NCAA expansion.
facts.quote: Eight teams will be added to each championship’s first round

facts.fact: The 'First Four' play-in round will be expanded from four games to 12 and renamed the 'Opening round'.
facts.quote: the ‘First Four’ play-in round expanded from four games to 12 (and will be renamed the ‘Opening round’)

facts.fact: The additional eight games in each tournament will net the NCAA an additional $50 million per year from media rights partners.
facts.quote: The additional eight games in each tournament will net the NCAA an additional $50 million per year from media rights partners

facts.fact: Through the end of the current broadcast deals in 2032, an additional $300 million will be drawn from the agreements due to the tournament expansion.
facts.quote: through the end of the current broadcast deals in 2032, an additional $300 million will be drawn from the agreements.

facts.fact: Beer, wine, spirits, and hard seltzer categories, previously restricted, are now available to the NCAA for sponsorship across the tournaments.
facts.quote: the previously restricted areas - beer, wine, spirits, and hard seltzer - all now available for the body to leverage via sponsorship.

facts.fact: ESPN will cover both annual Players Era men's tournaments, comprising 37 games in all, starting with the 2026 editions in November in Las Vegas.
facts.quote: ESPN will cover both annual men’s tournaments, 37 games in all, starting with the 2026 editions, which will take place in November in Las Vegas.
